## Intake
Validate WF-009 and select explicit structured knowledge.

## Knowledge Normalization
Preserve valid objects, remove invalid records, and sort timeline.

## Assembly
Generate BIB identity, sections, index, and summary without rewriting facts.

## Output
Emit one canonical Story Bible contract for WF-011.
